en: Vintage divided‑back postcard printed in Hungarian. The address side has the heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" and handwritten blue-ink script with a green postage stamp cancelled in 1911. The picture side shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a grand, ornate multi‑storey historicist building behind a decorative entrance gate with lamps. At the bottom of the image the caption identifies the scene in Hungarian.
